# pve_node_pci_devices (Data Source)

Lists the local PCI devices of one node (`GET /nodes/{node}/hardware/pci`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_node_pci_devices" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name whose PCI devices to list.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) PCI devices, sorted by PCI address upstream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `id` (String) Identifier in `node` form (same as the `node` attribute).

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `class` (String) The PCI class of the device (e.g. `0x0300`).
- `device` (String) The device ID.
- `device_name` (String) The human readable device name; null when unknown.
- `id` (String) The PCI address (e.g. `0000:01:00.0`).
- `iommugroup` (Number) The IOMMU group of the device; `-1` when no IOMMU group was detected.
- `mdev` (Boolean) Whether the device is capable of creating mediated devices; null when the host does not report it.
- `subsystem_device` (String) The subsystem device ID; null when the device has none.
- `subsystem_device_name` (String) The human readable subsystem device name; null when unknown.
- `subsystem_vendor` (String) The subsystem vendor ID; null when the device has none.
- `subsystem_vendor_name` (String) The human readable subsystem vendor name; null when unknown.
- `vendor` (String) The vendor ID.
- `vendor_name` (String) The human readable vendor name; null when unknown.
